patient_actor_hidden.History: Patient presents complaining of a persistent non-productive cough and breathlessness that started after a cold about a month ago. Describes previous health as generally good.
patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: Hypertension, Hyperlipidemia on Hydrochlorothiazide, Lisinopril, and Atorvastatin.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Non-smoker, drinks alcohol occasionally. Recently returned from a month-long trip to St. Louis, Missouri.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: No other symptoms apart from those mentioned.

objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and diagnose the patient presenting with a persistent non-productive cough and dyspnea following a recent cold.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Hello doctor—about a month ago I caught a cold, and since then I’ve had a persistent cough that doesn’t bring anything up, along with feeling short of breath. I’m otherwise doing pretty well, but this breathlessness and cough have been hanging on.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any areas of your skin that are scratched, rubbed raw, or have small open spots (excoriations)?
turns.patient_answer: “I haven’t noticed any scratched or rubbed raw skin, and I don’t have any small open spots or excoriations. I’ve mostly just had the persistent non-productive cough and the shortness of breath since that cold.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any episodes where you stop breathing or have pauses in breathing during sleep (for example, someone says you “stop” and then start again)?
turns.patient_answer: “Not that I’m aware of—no one has told me I stop breathing or have pauses during sleep, and I haven’t noticed myself waking up gasping.”

turns.doctor_question: After your minor injury, have you noticed any signs that a bone might be broken—like severe pain, swelling, bruising, deformity, or trouble using the area normally? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No—there wasn’t any injury, and I haven’t noticed severe pain, swelling, bruising, deformity, or trouble using any area normally.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any redness or warmth on your **left wrist** (the skin looking red compared to the other side)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed any redness or warmth on my left wrist, and the skin there doesn’t look different from the other side.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bruising on your chest wall (for example, dark or discolored areas on the chest), especially after an injury, coughing, or vomiting?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed any bruising or dark discoloration on my chest wall. I haven’t had any injury, and while I’ve been coughing, I haven’t seen any bruises appear on my chest.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been urinating much more than usual lately—like needing to go to the bathroom more often or producing a larger amount of urine?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed urinating more often than usual or producing a larger amount of urine. My main issues have been the persistent non-productive cough and feeling short of breath since the cold.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you used any substances that could affect your health—such as alcohol, tobacco/nicotine, cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or other drugs—either recently or in the past?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor. I don’t smoke or use tobacco or nicotine, and I only drink alcohol occasionally—I haven’t used cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or any other drugs.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any trouble controlling your urine—such as leaking or not making it to the bathroom in time? (yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t had any trouble controlling my urine, and I haven’t had any leaking or accidents. I can usually make it to the bathroom in time.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any new or changing skin spot, sore, or growth anywhere on your body? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed any new or changing skin spots, sores, or growths anywhere on my body.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had any nosebleeds recently (even a small amount), or blood coming from your nose?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor— I haven’t had any nosebleeds or any blood coming from my nose recently.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rash on your trunk (chest, back, or belly)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed any rash on my trunk, chest, back, or belly. My skin seems normal, apart from the persistent cough and breathlessness.”
